thought.text: User token issued (direct access grants works). Let me decode the token to confirm roles.

reasoning_content: Got the user token (HTTP 200), so Direct Access Grants is working. I'll try decoding the roles correctly.

action.command: TOK=$(cat /tmp/user-token.txt) && echo "$TOK" | cut -d. -f2 | base64 -d 2>/dev/null | jq '{realm_roles: .realm_access.roles, client_roles: .resource_access.strassennamen.roles}'

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "TOK=$(cat /tmp/user-token.txt) && echo \"$TOK\" | cut -d. -f2 | base64 -d 2>/dev/null | jq '{realm_roles: .realm_access.roles, client_roles: .resource_access.strassennamen.roles}'", "security_risk": "UNKNOWN", "summary": "Decode user token roles"}
